Q471656.label: genre
Q471656.description: creative work's genre or an artist's field of work (P101). Use main subject (P921) to relate creative works to their topic

Q471656.label: award received
Q471656.description: award or recognition received by a person, organization or creative work

Q471656.label: image
Q471656.description: image of relevant illustration of the subject; if available, also use more specific properties (sample: coat of arms image, locator map, flag image, signature image, logo image, collage image)

Q471656.label: place of birth
Q471656.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) birth location of a person, animal or fictional character

Q471656.label: sex or gender
Q471656.description: sex or gender identity of human or animal. For human: male, female, non-binary, intersex, transgender female, transgender male, agender, etc. For animal: male organism, female organism. Groups of same gender use subclass of (P279)

Q471656.label: father
Q471656.description: male parent of the subject. For stepfather, use "stepparent" (P3448)

Q471656.label: spouse
Q471656.description: the subject has the object as their spouse (husband, wife, partner, etc.). Use "unmarried partner" (P451) for non-married companions

Q471656.label: country of citizenship
Q471656.description: the object is a country that recognizes the subject as its citizen

Q471656.label: instance of
Q471656.description: that class of which this subject is a particular example and member; different from P279 (subclass of); for example: K2 is an instance of mountain; volcano is a subclass of mountain (and an instance of volcanic landform)

Q471656.label: educated at
Q471656.description: educational institution attended by subject

Q471656.label: instrument
Q471656.description: musical instrument that a person plays or teaches or used in a music occupation

Q471656.label: partner in business or sport
Q471656.description: professional collaborator

Q471656.label: described by source
Q471656.description: work where this item is described

Q471656.label: languages spoken, written or signed
Q471656.description: language(s) that a person or a people speaks, writes or signs, including the native language(s)

Q471656.label: number of children
Q471656.description: number of children of the person

Q471656.label: work period (start)
Q471656.description: start of period during which a person or group flourished (fl. = "floruit") in their professional activity

Q471656.label: height
Q471656.description: vertical length of an entity

Q471656.label: record label
Q471656.description: brand and trademark associated with the marketing of subject music recordings and music videos

Q471656.label: member of
Q471656.description: organization, club or musical group to which the subject belongs. Do not use for membership in ethnic or social groups, nor for holding a political position, such as a member of parliament (use P39 for that)

Q471656.label: date of birth
Q471656.description: date on which the subject was born

Q471656.label: family name
Q471656.description: part of full name of person

Q471656.label: given name
Q471656.description: first name or another given name of this person; values used with the property should not link disambiguations nor family names

Q471656.label: location of formation
Q471656.description: location where a group or organization was formed

Q471656.label: official website
Q471656.description: URL of the official page of an item (current or former). Usage: If a listed URL no longer points to the official website, do not remove it, but see the "Hijacked or dead websites" section of the Talk page

Q471656.label: social media followers
Q471656.description: number of subscribers on a particular social media website (use as main statement only; see P3744 instead for qualifier). Qualify with "point in time" and property for account. For Twitter, use numeric id.
